description: This is the entry JavaScript file for a React-based web application. It sets up the React application by importing necessary modules, including React, ReactDOM, CSS styles, and the main App component. It then uses ReactDOM to render the App component into the DOM element with the id 'root', within a React.StrictMode wrapper.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a React root for rendering the React component tree into a DOM element.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree into the DOM.
